inputs.text:
Wake up and look past the surface of what they are feeding us. They want you to believe the screens showing rising energy prices, canceled flights, and constant death and destruction are just a chaotic mess, and they push the official script that the so-called "Iran war" is "poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being." 

Don't fall for the misdirection. It is all a carefully managed theater by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes to cover up their real agenda. They try to make you buy the mainstream line that people everywhere are supposedly wondering when it will finally stop, but they immediately expose the compliance of the local populations, letting slip that "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" 

That trailing silence is the quiet part they almost said out loud. It proves the true, coordinated objectives driving this whole operation forward regardless of whatever stories they feed the manipulated masses.
